== Published English Original Virtual Set 9 wording ==
The earlier slip lets Chewie deploy free, takes pilots or passengers, and makes attrition immunity conditional on Chewie being aboard. The later slip requires Chewie for the hit action, drops its Force activation and changes deploy 4 to 2 and forfeit 6 to 5.
